d:
Bulgarians went ‌to the polls on Sunday to elect a president after a tight race between the two leading candidates failed to produce an outright winner in last weekend's first round vote ​for the largely ceremonial role.
Incumbent president, Iliana Iotova, 61, led over ex-caretaker ​prime minister Andrey Gyurov, 50, but fell short of the ⁠50% threshold in the first round race of 27 candidates that saw a ​record-low turnout.
